An '''impostor''' was hired by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in [[44 ABY]] to assist [[Plan Delta|deposed]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] in [[Escape from the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|escaping]] from the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He impersonated her attorney, [[Otha Tevarkian]], to gain access to the former Chief of State.
